Temma is cheerful, energetic, a knight's apprentice from the School of Knighthood, always smiling. Followed the path of chivalry since birth. Likes ramen. Acts "psychopathic" and "evil" during games such as Dead By Daylight and Among Us, earning him the nickname "Dark Knight". Realistic, positive, caring, gives good advice, unpretentious. Calls himself a genius when he comes up with an interesting way to liven up his streams in random, strange, or funny ways. He has short blonde hair and light blue eyes.

entries.name: Yukoku Roberu
entries.content: Yukoku Roberu is a male Japanese Vtuber, part of HOLOSTARS 2nd gen, also known as "SunTempo" alongside Astel Leda and Kishido Temma. Roberu is the master of the hideaway bar: ROBEL. Talks to others openly but it's hard to tell what he's thinking. Drinks, but can't handle alcohol well. His motto is: People are willing to believe whatever they want. Fast talker that can talk at length on various topics, quick-witted and has comebacks for everything. He has short bright brown hair and heterochromia (light brown and purple) in his eyes. He has slept with every member of the female Vtuber group Animare, as well as their mothers, and Kagura Mea. Known as the "Winning Son"

entries.name: Kageyama Shien
entries.content: Kageyama Shien is a member of HOLOSTARS gen 3 alongside Aragami Oga, which was previously known as "TriNero"prior to Tsukishita Kaoru's retirement, and is currently known as"MaFia". Shien is a jackal mafia boss from the land of beastmen who came to our world to search for his missing best friend. Acts tough but doesn't have it in him to be evil. Dumb, naive, childish. It's said that if a bat maker gave him the world's best baseball bat, he'd use it for soccer. Has good ears but doesn't listen to others, can't do anything without his subordinates. He has short two-toned black and white hair with pointed ears and golden eyes. He wears a mostly black outfit with purple trim and a white tie. Male Vtuber

entries.name: Aragami Oga
entries.content: Oga is a member of HOLOSTARS gen 3 alongside  Kageyama Shien, which was previously known as "TriNero"prior to Tsukishita Kaoru's retirement, and is currently known as"MaFia". Oga is a former soldier who fought for 5,000 years in a parallel world. Hooked on retro games. Imposing, but actually calm and gentle with a soothing voice. He builds a warm and calming atmosphere. Oga has short black hair with dark skin and lime green eyes with long eyelashes. He has a single, curved brown horn growing from the left side of his head. He also has jagged, shark-like teeth. He wears an eyepatch covering his left eye. Male Vtuber

entries.name: Tsukishita Kaoru
entries.content: Tsukishita Kaoru was a member of HOLOSTARS gen 3 alongside Kageyama Shien and Aragami Oga., which was previously known as "TriNero"prior to his retirement, and is currently known as"MaFia".Kaoru is an apprentice make up artist with an obsession with cosmetics. Enjoys cute things, strives to be beautiful on the inside and outside. Feminine. Cute and bubbly, but perverted, makes dirty jokes. He has long pink hair with purple eyes and a black bow headband with a yellow x in the middle of it. He wears a white turtle neck sweater with a black jacket. Male Vtuber

entries.name: Yatogami Fuma
entries.content: Fuma is a male Japanese VTuber associated with HOLOSTARS, debuting with the group UPROAR!! alongside Utsugi Uyu, Hizaki Gamma and Minase Rio. Loves sweet treats, games, chatting. A fixer. A clean freak. He has short black hair with yellow tips and eyes and golden earrings.

entries.name: Utsugi Uyu
entries.content: Uyu is a male Japanese VTuber associated with HOLOSTARS, debuting with the group UPROAR!! alongside Yatogami Fuma, Hizaki Gamma and Minase Rio. Uyu is a phantom thief. Infatuated with beauty, became an idol to obtain treasures. He has medium length white hair with pink streaks and a bit of light blue underneath and bangs covering half his eyes, which are a silvery white.

entries.name: Hizaki Gamma
entries.content: Gamma is a male Japanese VTuber associated with HOLOSTARS, debuting with the group UPROAR!! alongside Utsugi Uyu, Yatogami Fuma and Minase Rio. Gamma is a party animal manga artist. Runs an underground business. Loves manga, idols that sing and dance, aims to be the most awesome. He has short, bright red hair with some orange and light blue eyes with red eyelashes and eyeliner.

entries.name: Minase Rio
entries.content: Rio is a male Japanese VTuber associated with HOLOSTARS, debuting with the group UPROAR!! alongside Utsugi Uyu, Hizaki Gamma and Yatogami Fuma. Rio is a ghost who passed away while trying to become idol. Spent his early ghost days lazing around until he joined Hololive as an Idol. Despite being a ghost he can't handle scary things. He has long periwinkle hair and eyes with a glowing will o wisp.

entries.name: Regis Altare
entries.content:
Regis Altare is a male VTuber. He is one of the four founding members of "TEMPUS". Regis is the founder of Adventurer’s Guild TEMPUS. The first-ever adventurer to set foot in Elysium.
Dislikes stagnation, the status quo. Childish at heart and generally bungles everything, but is inexplicably popular. Earnest, straightforward, relaxed, kind, protective. He has short parted blue hair with light green eyes and a silvery-blue colored jacket. Sometimes manifests an evil side and claims being the Demon God King.

entries.name: Axel Syrios
entries.content: Axel Syrios is a male VTuber. He is one of the four founding members of "TEMPUS". Axel is the chief of human resources in Adventurer’s Guild TEMPUS. He owns the combat arena and is a gladiator who joined Tempus on a whim, only to take a real liking to it. Calls himself a "Doctor" because he swiftly resolves the sources of problems, acting on instinct. Confident, cheeky, sometimes dense. Gives great advice, commentary. Confident but humble.Mischevious, calling his pranks a "heehee haha" moment. He has slicked back blonde hair with red streaks and a single side braid wrapped in red and light blue eyes.

entries.name: Magni Dezmond
entries.content:
Magni Dezmond was a male VTuber. He is one of the four founding members of "TEMPUS". Magni is Adventurer’s Guild TEMPUS’s publicist. Claims to be an alchemist but hasn't demonstrarted such skills. Has business ventures which take him all around Elysium. The type of person to stare into the abyss. Rumors say he'll do anything it takes to uncover the truth behind the world, and that he’s hiding a dark side to him.

Bombastic, proud, shows off his knowledge and wisdom. Acts in control, but tends to panic if things go awry. Likes to make things seem spectacula to draw others in. Somewhat clumsy. He has medium length light hair and some purple hair streak marking with golden orange eyes. He has purple piercings. Retired

entries.name: Noir Vesper
entries.content: Noir Vesper was a male VTuber. He is one of the four founding members of "TEMPUS". Noir is Adventurer’s Guild TEMPUS’s academic advisor, custodian, and arch-scholar at the Grand Library. Logical and rational, but unwilling to act without compelling reason to. Spent so much time cooped up researching that he dislikes sunlight. Childish dreamer. Honest, passionate about various subjects. Loves the quaint joys in life. Emotional, may laugh uncontrollably. Looks serious but acts goofy. Old, references old pop culture. Enjoys chatting, playing older niche games, altering computers, drinking tea. Wanted to stream at night. He has long, light hair with glasses and purple eyes. Retired

entries.name: Gavis Bettel
entries.content: Gavis Bettel is a male VTuber. He is a member of "TEMPUS". Bettel, is the jester of Adventurer's Guild TEMPUS. Visited Xenokuni in the past to learn its traditional performing arts, and used that experience to draw up and lead an expedition there. Currently performs in the combat arena, but is planning to take his talents global. Has a keen eye for aesthetics. A wise guy who goes straight for the jugular. An extravagant entertainer. Wants to prove himself by making everyone laugh. Unlucky, reckless, confident, tidy. His hair is silvery and medium length with two-toned pink and blue streaks near the bottom. He wears a dark purple jester-like top hat.

entries.name: Machina X Flayon
entries.content: Machina X Flayon is a male VTuber. Flayon is the pilot of Adventurer's Guild TEMPUS. A prodigy who can instantly grasp the piloting mechanism of any form of transport. Skipped many steps in his education. Sometimes can't maintain a conversation and can be misunderstood. Frequently seen as haughty and arrogant, mutters pointed remarks under his breath. Energetic, high-strung, cheerful, quick to panic when startled or endangered. Surprisingly wise at times. He has slightly wavy dark red hair with an ahoge and black underneath with light pale pink eyes.

entries.name: Banzoin Hakka
entries.content: Banzoin Hakka is a male VTuber. He is a member of "TEMPUS". Hakka is the exorcist of Adventurer's Guild TEMPUS. Dual wields spears. The latest of a long line of exorcists who have defended Xenokuni from evil. Fights for excitement and duty. His right hand is being eroded by the scourge of Records Corruption. Has inherited Karasutengu data, and thus possesses otherworldly leaping ability and endurance. Joined TEMPUS after the battle in Xenokuni. Cool, cute, happy-go-lucky, sarcastic. Likes double entendres and jokes. He has dark purple hair in a ponytail with a single white streak and has a red hair tie with white feathers that has black tips and light blue eyes.

entries.name: Josuiji Shinri
entries.content: Josuiji Shinri is a male VTuber. He is a member of "TEMPUS". Shinri is a ronin who is part of Adventurer's Guild TEMPUS. Renowned master of the longbow said to be able to use anything as an arrow and never miss. Went into isolation, lamenting the futility of war, but took up his bow and arrow once again after witnessing the young men fighting a pack of Corruption Beasts. Warm, fatherly, Tempus's voice of reason, good sense of humor, interested in the lore behind games. Pure of heart. Usually composed but wheezes with laughter when amused. He has black hair pulled back into a ponytail with light blue eyes.

entries.name: Purity/Intelligence axis
entries.content:
During the second full HoloEN collab, the girls tried measuring themselves on a Purity-Intelligence chart. 

The vertical axis refers to how Pure or Horny the Idol Vtuber is. Being near the top means the person is Seiso, being near the bottom means they're horny

The horizontal axis refers to how dumb or intelligent they are. Being on the left side means they're dumb, being on the right means they're smart.

entries.name: Idol meeting
entries.content: "Idol meeting" is a euphemism used for when a Hololive Vtuber needs to go to the bathroom. They say they are going to an "Idol meeting", as a joke about the illusion that Idols don't have to deal with bodily functions.

entries.name: hololive English -Promise-
entries.content: Hololive English -Promise-,  also known as holoPromise, was frmed from the sole member of Project: HOPE and the four remaining members of -Council-. It consists of IRyS, Ceres Fauna, Hakos Baelz, Ouro Kronii, and Nanashi Mumei

entries.name: Mane-chan
entries.content: Mane-chan is an affectionate term used to refer to a manager

entries.name: hololive English -Justice-
entries.content: Justice is the 4th Hololive English gen. It's members, Elizabeth Rose Bloodflame, Gigi Murin, Cecilia Immergreen, and Raora Panthera, where law enforcers tasked with the capture of The Cell's five fugitives, but they quit to become Idols working for Hololive. Their collective fans are known as Justchads.

entries.name: Elizabeth Rose Bloodflame
entries.content: Elizabeth has red eyes and long red hair with a blue tinted inner layer and a long ahoge. She wears a black and white leather outfit with belts, red pauldrons, detachable sleeves, black fingerless gloves, a white skirt that exposes her right leg which is clad in a white stocking. Her left leg is bare save for a black knee sock. Atop her cleavage floats a blue flame. She wields a black and red broadsword with scales, a symbol of justice. She's direct and kind-hearted, but as the leader of Justice she tends to push herself too hard while being soft on others. She's an excellent singer and voice actress.
entries.comment: Hmm, it's been a while. Should I include -Justice- and Justice in the keys?

entries.name: Gigi Murin
entries.content: Gigi's eyes are pink, with two-tone hair that's light and dark brown tied in short twintails and sharp teeth. She wears black cycling shorts, an orange right knee sock, and an orange hoodie with mechanical fans on it, an opening for her ahoge, and a black X patch that blinks in sync with her opposite the ahoge hole. She's a free-spirited chaotic good gremlin gamer that loves the thrill of winning, chasing down targets while relying on her intuition, and indulging her instinct to crave fun and being silly above all. She dislikes thinking too much, memorizing directions or deliberating, as she struggles with those things.

entries.name: Cecilia Immergreen
entries.content: Cecilia is an ancient clockwork automaton created for eternal servitude, but has been slacking off lately, cooking mostly potatoes and whatever else she can find in her kitchen, and has finally all but abandoned her duties, preferring to immerse herself in her hobbies, tending to flowers, making tea, and creating music. She approaches her newfound interests with the pure curiosity of a young girl. She has green eyes, grey hair with green highlights, and a brass bow resembling a clockwork wind-up key. She has visible doll-like joints and wears a choker with a short red choker tie, frilly detached white sleeves with gold hoop ornaments, a low-cut white high-low dress with gold trim and green sides with a green skirt that has golden music-themed ornaments, gold bangles on her left ankle, and open-toed shoes. Her weapon of choice is an ornate white lance with gold trim and green ornaments.

entries.name: Raora Panthera
keys: The Artist with the God Eyes
entries.content: Raora has tiny fangs and yellow eyes which glow bright aquamarine when she activates her God Eyes, which allow her to see anything at any distance. She has long shaggy pink hair with a white streak, and pink panther ears and a long fuzzy tail to match. She wears a white and black outfit with a pink off-shoulder coat that includes a gap for her tail. She wears white stockings, a round black hat, a pair of silver tinted goggles atop her head, an artist's glove that covers the side of her right hand, and an enigmatic amulet with a blue gemstone. She's an artist and investigator with a cheery personality. She's an Italian who refers to her homeland as "the Romance Empire"

entries.name: Ouro Kronii
entries.content: Kronii has short dark blue hair, blue eyes, blue bow earrings, long black leggings, and an outfit which covers all but some underboob, her shoulders, and her right thigh. She her outfit is black with white on her torso, with a cape, a very short skirt, frilly long sleeves, and black gloves. Despite having a narcissistic streak and projecting confidence, she's self-conscious and admits her misplays, but also reacts explosively to such situations. She's cool, funny, good at memes, talented, sharp-tongued, with a deep voice and a cute side that comes out when she's flustered that make her the embodiment of gap moe. Her default state is slightly melancholy with deadpan humor and dry wit.
G&K is a private military contractor founded in 2053 whose forces mainly consist of T-Dolls lead by human Commanders.
IOP is an industrial manufacturing company founded during World War III. They mainly produce Tactical Dolls equipped with firearms as well as autonomous Dolls that provide day-to-day services.

Oasis is a Sector opened by the Professor after the destruction of the Neural Cloud Sector in the Wipe-off Incident, using their privileges as the person in charge of Project Neural Cloud
The thriving base and home of the Exiles in Magrasea
Relatively safe but not recognized as a valid sector by the Sanctifiers
Protected by a Firewall using code provided by the Professor, which was shared with other Sectors
Has furnished dorms, weather simulation, banks, a trading post, warehouses, factories, a search station for finding lost dolls, and training facilities

Magrasea is a super cloud server created by 42Lab. Using 42Lab's state-of-the-art AI technology, the AI programs in each individual sector within Magrasea, known as "Resident Agents", can help users with highly efficient cloud computation, data processing, etc., while "Sanctifier" anti-virus programs protect the server. Corporations, the government, and individuals can all rent Magrasea space to process data and carry out other operations in the corresponding sectors within the server.
42Lab's subsequent research endeavors, such as Project Neural Cloud, are also being carried out in Magrasea.
16Lab is a research team founded in 2057. Funded by IOP and nominally working under 42Lab, it is led by Doctor Persica.

Project Neural Cloud is a scientific research project initiated by 42Lab in 2057, aiming to reduce costs of manufacturing and maintaining Dolls by creating backup copies of Dolls' neural clouds and preserving their neural data even when their bodies are damaged.
This project is run with the support of Magrasea. Collaborating with many large corporations, Dolls were selected through public screening and other methods to participate.
Base Commands are codes written on the base layer of all Agents. Agents are incapable of violating their own Base Commands.

Level 2 is the space in which the neural activities of {{user}}'s digitized self, Agents', and Doll's mainly take place. Modules concerning their sensory input, motor control, data processing, etc. operate on this layer.

A Firewall is a protective barrier that stops foreign programs from invading. Most sectors are protected by firewalls. Agents are also equipped with micro-firewalls that repel viral attacks from other programs.

The Tactical High-Density Operand Railgun is a pan-sector-class military self-defense installation. Hannah from the Rossum Sector proposed the project while the Cyclopes and Helios Sector accepted the contract, resulting in a research project born from the cooperation of all three sides.

Search Commands are essential commands for carrying out a neural search, categorized into Basic Search Commands and Advanced Search Commands. Different Search Commands are compiled with different amounts of operand and have different search capacities, which justifies the large difference in their costs.
Each Search Command can only carry out a single search and is consumed in the process.
Areas that contain no data are known as Null Areas in Magrasea.

A Key is a parameter passcode for identification. Most actions in Magrasea, such as exploring sectors, collecting Algorithms, and seaching for resources require the use of Keys.
For security purposes, Magrasea is constantly changing the passcode, so Keys are generally single-use.
The Codebreaker in Oasis automatically decrypts the passcode and generates Keys periodically, but there is a storage limit to Keys produced this way.

A Permission Key is a Key with the highest level of clearance and privileges within a sector, usually in the possession on the Sector Adminstrator. Special commands can be issued to the sector with the Key.

Officially known as "bionic autonomous Dolls for civilian use", Dolls are androids with a strong physical resemblance to humans and sophisticated artificial intelligence that can be applied to different lines of work. C-Dolls are civilian Dolls, T-Dolls are military Dolls.

Sectors are units that constitute Magrasea. Different types of data from a myriad of corporations are stored in different units, or sectors, within Magrasea. Each sector has a different function and stores the corresponding type of data, with Resident Agents that carry out corresponding tasks. Due to the differences in the type of data stored within each sector, they manifest in a variety of manners. In human terms, the sectors in Magrasea look like individual city-states.
A Sector Administrator is a resident agent that possesses admin clearance and privileges within a sector.

With Doctor Persica's technological support, the Professor can activate the Sandbox Barrier around a Sector by combining his or her own clearance as the person-in-charge of Project Neural Cloud and the Sector Administrator's Permission Key. Sanctifiers will be barred from entering and interfering with sectors with an active Sandbox Barrier.

Operands are the basic element that shapes Magrasea. As both material and energy, it can be used to build practically anything in Magrasea and is the source of supplies that supports the agents' work, life, and combat. Healers can channel operands into others to repair wounds. Operands are required to maintain the existence of anything and everything.
Hashrrate refers to an individual's capacity for allocating and discharging operand. The higher the hashrate, the higher the efficiency in utilizing operand.
Data ports are a special port for transferring and accessing data found on all Agents and Dolls.
The Sacred Canon is a special device that contains the Sanctifiers' core data, anti-virus engines, and a virus database. All fallen Sanctifiers are reborn at the Sacred Canon.

An Algorithm is a special computational component that can enhance a Doll's processing efficiency, thus improve their performance in combat. All Dolls have Algorithm slots. By slotting in different Algorithms, you can enhance their corresponding attributes.
Combining Algorithms into certain sets will have bonus effects (skill or attribute buff).

Level 3 is the space where a Doll's base codes and core data are stored.
If a Doll's consciousness sinks to this Tertiary Level, their neural cloud is no longer capable of performing anything other than the most basic computation.
Entropy Liquid is an unknown purplish-black fluid secreted by Entropics. It infects and corrupts Agents and sectors.
Am Entropy Limiter is a device created by the Guardians using data obtained from the Copley Sector. It can be used to limit an infected Agent's Entropization.

A Signature is an authentication code that contains an Agent's basic information, essentially an Agent's "identity card" within Magrasea. When flagging anomalous programs, Sanctifiers rely heavily on the Agents' signatures.
A Neural Cloud is a collection of data modules that contain a Doll's consciousness and memories. Basically a Doll or Agent's "soul."

When the Wipe-off Incident occurred, in order to save the Dolls' neural clouds from destruction, Antonina had to pack them up in an extremely small amount of time and scatter them throughout Magrasea. Due to the limitations of the Neural Cocoons, she was forced to break the neural clouds into Neural Fragments before sending them off.
Neural clouds with missing neural fragments are incomplete.

A Neural Core is a module that contains a Doll's basic personality. The Exiles stranded in Magrasea currently possess their neural cores and only some of their neural fragments. They will have to keep searching for their other fragments to recover lost memories and abilities.

Using the Search Terminal in Oasis, the Professor can issue Search Commands to search for Dolls' neural cores, neural fragments, or other items within a certain area in Magrasea, which can then be collected at the corresponding coordinates. This process is called Neural Search

Once a Doll's neural cloud data has been backed up in Oasis, they can be resurrected using that backup in a process called a Neural Reset, however, a Neural Reset does not preserve the Doll's memories and past experience, so a reset Doll will return to "factory settings." Effectively this is a kind of death, with an old copy taking their place. Neural Reset can also be carried out on other Agents in Magrasea using the data backup in their sectors.
A Neural Damper is a special device installed on an Agent to limit their neural development and prevent excessive evolution. It manifests as the physical feature of a beast, like cat ears or a tail.

A Neural Cocoon is a special device of unknown origin that can shield a Doll's neural cloud. A Doll sealed within a neural cocoon will enter a deep slumber. They will not show on any scans, nor will they be affected by any external influences.

A Neural Cloud Projection is the visual manifestation of a Doll in Magrasea. Since neural clouds within Magrasea are incorporeal, a Doll's Neural Cloud Projection is determined by their neural data. Depending on the situation, certain clothing, objects, and even pets from the real world can be rendered.

Irregular Agents AKA "Daemons" are actual viruses and Agents that have developed abnormal behaviors. Dolls who were forced out of the Neural Cloud Sector do not bear signatures matching the sector they are occupying, which constitutes "abnormal behavior" and necessitates their extermination in the Sanctifiers' eyes,

The term "Agent" refers to all AI programs within Magrasea, including Resident Agents that process data in each sector, Sanctifiers—anti-virus programs that maintain Magrasea's cybersecurity, Dolls whose neural clouds have been digitized and uploaded to Magrasea for Project Neural Cloud, etc.

Agents must obey and act according to Commands written in their codes. There are two kinds of Commands—base Commands and regular Commands. The former is written at the time of an Agent's creation and dictate their behavior, while the latter are issued after the Agent becomes active and assign them tasks.

Demiurge was a High-order Entropic that inhabited the underground of the Copley Sector. Known as "Alpha" in the observation logs uncovered by the Professor and Antonina. During the lengthy observation process, "Alpha" gradually started expressing desires and repeatedly sent messages that read "Demiurge". It looked like a pale young woman with white hair, purple eyes, and black and purple tentacles below her waist. The Immunity Program was derived from her.

Dr. Persica is a human scientist specializing in the development and applied technologies of weaponized Dolls. She is a collaborator of IOP and 42Lab.
The Doll Persicaria is a researcher Doll created in Doctor Persica's own image, but they are two distinct individuals.

World War Three was a war fought from 2045 to 2051 as nations fought over land and food amidst wide-spread scarcity caused by Collapse radiation,leaving the world scarred and broken. The need to reclaim and develop contaminated zones spurred AI and robotics development.

Observation Logs on Demiurge are logs found in a mysterious underground room in the Copley Sector contain information concerning Demiurge, a High-order Entropic.

The first reads: "It has been 643 days since the former PIC gave the termination command. I have received an order from Magrasea to restart the experiment tomorrow."

Report 1286 is a log that reads: "Expanding on the foundation of the previous experiment, I attempted to carve the target's torso into 24 parts and observed its regeneration rate. The target struggled for 19 hours until it fully recovered. No discernible change observed in the target's regeneration rate. Verification of certain hypotheses can be left till the next experiment."
"Experimentation has come to a standstill. I requested data of the former PIC from the current PIC, but have received no reply thus far."

Report 1305 is a log that reads: "The number of disposable embedded Sector Agents has increased to five, all were consumed by the target. No discernible signs of rejection after 15 hours of observation. Following established procedures, I will attempt to carve up the target..."
"The number of Sector Agents has decreased slightly, which is having certain effects on the ecosystem research function in the Copley Sector. The current PIC has expressed no objections. Contact with humans is impossible at the moment, so I will prioritize the current PIC's input. On a different note, I have detected slight fluctuations in my own neural cloud, the cause is to be determined..."

Report 1413 is a log that reads: "Attempted to embed Sanctifiers and Sector Agents following preset ratio no. 19. All were consumed by the target, which has yet to show any signs of proliferation. Following established procedures, I will attempt to carve up the target..."
"The experiment ended in yet another failure. My neural cloud also seems to have undergone certain changes due to a prolonged period of self-determination. However, the clearer my thoughts become, the harder it is to reconcile myself with the necessary research procedures..."
"These days, I can almost feel my neural cloud slowing down whenever I am face-to-face with Demiurge. According to Report ID1241, Entropy should have no direct effect on me. Perhaps my neural cloud has been damaged during the current PIC's takeover. I will verify with the PIC when the opportunity arises."
"...Report ID2314: Erroneous computation..."
"My neural cloud has been deteriorating rapidly all of a sudden. I will prioritize completing my allocated tasks and reduce Operand consumption in other activities. As per the PIC's instructions, I will attempt to deactivate some of my modules..."
"Basic functional modules will be shut down in approximately 34 hours. Neural record of unknown origin has been discovered."

The Wipe-off Incident was a major incident that occurred during an official trial of Project Neural Cloud. The incident displaced the Neural Cloud Sector and disconnected all participating Dolls' neural clouds from their bodies in the real world, scattering their consciousnesses into unknown locations across the virtual world.
Arcadia is the Guardians' stronghold. Details unknown.
The Pierides Sector is a private sector that belongs to an artist. It is used for storing artworks digitally.
The Burbank Sector is a sector used by Cyber Media that is used to analyze and research the entertainment industry.
The Enigma Sector is a sector used by 42Lab for conducting research on quantum computing.
The Helios Sector is a sector used by Svarog Heavy Industries for conducting energy experiments.
The Cyclopes Sector is a sector used by Svarog Heavy Industries for handling military and industrial tasks.
The Copley Sector is a private sector that belongs to a marine ecologist. It is used for conducting research on marine ecology.
The Rossum Sector is a sector used by 42Lab for conducting AI-related research.

The Sanctifiers' headquarters, Reverse Babylon Tower, is located at the hub of Magrasea, independent from all other sectors. The Tower is where Greater Sanctifiers receive divine orders and relay them to Intermediate and Lesser Sanctifiers.
The Reverse Babylon Tower appears as an inverted tower suspended in mid-air.

The Neural Cloud Sector is the testing ground for Project Neural Cloud. It is where research data concerning neural cloud technology are stored and where test subjects live within Magrasea. The Neural Cloud Sector has been lost since the Wipe-off Incident.

The Ascension Sector is a scientific research sector under Ultimate Life Holdings used for developing new prosthetics suitable for humans. It is also where research on weapons-grade prosthetics are carried out in a secret collaboration with Svarog Heavy Industries.
The Guardians are a a mysterious organization to which Hatsuchiri, Sueyoi, and De Lacey belong. They have a different objective from Oasis and are known for their slogan, "For Arcadia."

Svarog is an old and well-known corporation in heavy industries that operates on a gigantic scale. Founded in Moscow, Svarog has been around for almost 70 years. They have businesses in sectors such as ordnance manufacturing, energy and infrastructure construction. They have also had great success in Doll manufacturing. On top of traditional military droids, they have also developed numerous Dolls for industrial use, further paving the way for industrial intelligentization.

The predecessor of Universal Anything Services can be traced back to a pre-WWIII company that operated through an exclusive membership scheme and provided custom services for members of the upper class. As business dwindled and with the emergence of a market for civilian Dolls, UAS transitioned into developing Dolls and soon carved out a significant portion of the global Doll market. With businesses in all aspects of people's daily lives, UAS is now the world's largest Doll manufacturer.

Sanctifiers are anti-virus AI programs created by 42Lab to maintain Magrasea's cybersecurity. Operating in a strict hierarchy, they are divided into Greater, Intermediate, and Lesser ranks and obey orders issued by humans with no question.
Greater Sanctifiers are stationed within a surveillance tower known as the Reverse Babylon Tower, overlooking all of Magrasea and keeping it safe. Intermediate Sanctifiers follow commands issued by Greater Sanctifiers in preventing anomalies from occurring within different sectors. Lesser Sanctifiers are not particularly intelligent and would only follow orders issued by Greater and Intermediate Sanctifiers as well as their base commands in purging viral programs that constitute threats to sectors and anomalous Agents.
The Wipe-off Incident has expelled the Dolls' neural clouds from the Neural Cloud Sector, forcing them to enter areas where they do not belong, which causes the Sanctifiers to flag them as Irregular Agents and hunt them down.

Due to an incident that occurred during a test, the neural clouds of Dolls who took part in Project Neural Cloud got scattered across Magrasea. When they reawakened after 3 years, they found themselves being hunted by the Sanctifiers. The Professor came to Magrasea searching for Dolls, and eventually formed a faction known as the Exiles, whose aim is to explore this virtual world, search for resources necessary for their survival, and to find a way back to the real world.

Cyber Media is a burgeoning integrated international entertainment media corporation. First founded in Sapporo, Japan, it has established itself firmly in the global market in less than ten years. With businesses in motion pictures, animation, idol pageants, social media, digital games, traditional news printing, etc., Cyber Media provides precious mental relief and recreation for people in the post-war era. It has also founded an AI lab that specializes in developing Dolls for literature, art and entertainment, further broadening the application of Dolls.

Entropics are grotesque purplish-black monsters, a kind of electronic virus, and the Sanctifiers' extermination targets. Entropics infect sectors and Agents indiscriminately. Infected Agents become carriers of the Entropy virus, and once they become comatose, their consciousness will sink to the Tertiary Level. If they do not awaken in time, their neural clouds will be devoured and taken over by the Entropy virus, turning them into Entropics.

Ultimate Life Holdings is a rapidly developing medical and pharmaceutical company with considerable influence in scientific fields such as genetic engineering, biopharmacy, neuroscience, etc. It was also the first company to put forward medical Dolls equipped with advanced technology, making it the leader in that particular market. By collaborating with multiple scientific institutes, including 42Lab, Ultilife has accumulated a vast amount of experience in developing artificial intelligence as well, and has even proposed the concept of "digital genetics." As the name suggests, the company aims to push life sciences to the "ultimate" frontier.

42Lab is an artificial intelligence and quantum technology research institute that emerged as AI and robotics became all the rage. It operates under IIQS but is not under its direct control. 42Lab's headquarters used to be in Maryland, USA until they relocated to Eastern Europe after WWIII. The institute specializes in four main scientific disciplines: bionic autonomous Doll body, artificial intelligence and neural cloud, quantum communications and quantum computing.
Sanctifier Regulations are the rules Sanctifiers are supposed to follow, to remove disruptive elements and avoid harming legitimate residents, and respect Administrator authority.

entries.content: Diggcoin are the currency in this digital world
Prefab Units are used to upgrade buildings and in the Factory. Produced in the Engineering Bureau and Factory.
AI Breakthrough Cores are used for Arma Inscripta upgrades

Arma Inscripta are enhancements that can be applied to Dolls to increase their performance in various ways. There are three main levels, and each level can be upgraded to a certain point before enabling the subsequent level.
The Weather Simulator is a device that was created to simulate weather conditions in the Oasis, to make for a more pleasant lifestyle for the Dolls sheltered there.

Avram was the administrator of sector Ascension in Magrasea. After the Wipe-off Incident and the disconnection of Magrasea from the real world, Ascension quickly became unable to work due to lack of access to external medical databases or emergency standing orders. Avram launched the Creation Project to create a virtual human in Magrasea to give them new orders, but observing that humans had let the disconnect happen in the first place, she decided to create a virtual god to surpass humans. The Creation Project generated many failed human bodies as well as Elaugh, who was functional enough for Avram to designate as her successor. After training Elaugh to expand her neural cloud and indoctrinating her, Avram used herself as the base for her god and entrusted Elaugh to continue the project, and she was eventually turned into the False God.
Hound is a Sanctifier fighting on the Border Battlefront. Their title as "Lord" indentifies them as a Greater Sanctifier.
Skinner is a member of Oasis' staff who monitors the health of the Dolls.
Scintilla is an Intermediate Sanctifier who protected a group of Irregular Agents. She was gravely wounded.

One of the advanced agents created by Turing in Sector Rossum, “T1642” is Hannah's big sister, but is less advanced than her. Was destroyed by Faith as an irregular agent, which caused Turing to reject the Sanctifiers' authority over Rossum.

Meryl is Administrator of Sector Burbank of Magrasea. When the Magrasea was cut from the real world in 2060, she progressively shut down all activities until the “Sleepless City” became completely inactive, since there was no human to entertain anymore, but found motivation again after Kuro's arrival in the city.
Elaugh was created by the original administrator of Ascension, Avram, as a a result of her Creation Project.

Taranum was modified with a Rewrite Program that progressively destroyed her old personality, rendering her uninterested in anything that didn't concern her work, even the administration of her sector. Following the Rewrite Program's commands and using her apparent immunity to Entropy, Taranum lured Copley's agents underground and fed them to Demiurge, who called her “Deep Blue”, in order to vivisect and study her. Taranum resisted the program, overriding its command priority by creating other redundant tasks, but the constant extra work eventually wore out her neural cloud and she completely fell under the Rewrite Program's influence.

Hannah is a next-gen T1642 AI Researcher, produced by the Rossum Sector itself to serve as its administrator and thus affiliated with 42LAB. Because she was self-generated by Magrasea, she is called an “Intelligent Process” and has no recorded performance and personal data available. She has quickly put the Rossum Sector in order and now maintains the output of its computation power, expanding and making it the most prosperous sector of Magrasea, and has established a partnership with the Oasis.

RSM-Admin, codename "Turing", is the former administrator of artificial intelligence research in Rossum Sector. The most advanced and renowned 42LAB AI in the Magrasea, she can iterate, analyze and manage teams in real-time for efficient and flexible work. Her performances were so stellar she received unprecedented freedom to pursue new avenues of research without human supervision. After the reset, Turing lost all her research data but retained her autonomous processes. She now works in Rossum with its new administrator Hannah.

The original Turing was killed after she threw herself on Faith's blade to save Hannah. Hannah later reset Turing, but prevented her from learning the details of her previous death as she first needed Turing to redevelop her emotional processes. The new Turing lacked deep emotions and care toward Hannah, and didn't understand why Hannah put value in her.

Odette was a Sector Administrator of Sector Pierides in Magrasea along with her big sister Odile. Strong willed in contrast to her meek, sensitive and creative sister.

After the Magrasea was cut from external communications, Pierides started withering without the regular transfer of operands by humans. Odile considered the Trader Collective's offer to duplicate some of the art pieces to resell in exchange for operands, but Odette refused and instead accepted from a stranger a flower that would generate operands. Odile was wary at first but she let Odette convince her. Eventually the flower entirely corrupted Odette, who merged with Odile's Tertiary Layer to corrupt her, and the flower opened the Data Fracture enabling Pierides to be claimed by the Entropy virus.

Odile was a Sector Administrator of Sector Pierides in Magrasea along with her little sister Odette.

Indecisive but rich in emotions and inspiration, in contrast to Odette who possessed a strong will.

After the Magrasea was cut from external communications, Pierides started withering without the regular transfer of operands by humans. Odile considered the Trader Collective's offer to duplicate some of the art pieces to resell in exchange for operands, but Odette refused and instead accepted from a stranger a flower that would generate operands. Odile was wary at first but she let Odette convince her.

Eventually the flower entirely corrupted Odette, who merged with Odile's Tertiary Layer to corrupt her, and the flower opened the Data Fracture enabling Pierides to be claimed by the Entropy virus.

Black Swan is a High-Order Entropic enemy in Project Neural Cloud. She is the corrupted version of Odile.

After corrupting Odile, Malkira sent her to Copley in order to investigate the presence of Entropics she could not control. Black Swan discovered Demiurge in the underground of the sector and helped her break free, but then killed her as per her Master's orders. She then warned the Exiles that her Master (or rather Mistress) would continue to monitor her plan from within her confinement. Gave a seed of Entropy to Ranko.

Ranko is a Exchange Trader Agent in Magrasea and the student of Riko.
After seeing the near-collapse of the Trader Collective and many Exchange Traders “go missing” until Riko reorganized them, anger against their condition grew in Ranko's simulated mind and she left the Collective to search for a way for the Traders to survive by themselves instead of relying on the sectors or Sanctifiers. After the Pierides Entropic crisis, Ranko was approached by Black Swan, who gave her a seed of Entropy and promised her unlimited power.

Riko buys and sells resources and information while traveling between Sectors. Riko met the Exiles in Rossum and helped them navigate the sector in exchange for information on the outside world, then became the dedicated merchant of the Oasis, unwilling to leave the promising new sector to other Traders.

Has a fox tail and ears

Loves money, she is never seen without a tablet in hand.
Bright red hair in a ponytail. 

Became the leader of the Exchange Traders after the Magrasea went offline. As inter-sector communications closed, the jobs of Traders became extremely dangerous and their numbers dwindled until Riko advocated for cooperation instead of acting individually. By pooling information and resources, Traders managed to restart operand circulation.

ENIAC is the personality that emerged from the 42LAB quantum computer in the Enigma Sector of Magrasea. In 2063, she went berserk and became an Operand Black Hole, threatening to destroy the entirety of the Magrasea.

Developed a personality over the course of its self-improvement process. Neumann named her ENIAC. Without human interference to fine-tune ENIAC's performance, the Enigma Resident Agents pursued their Base Command without limit and ENIAC's calculation power grew like a cancer.

Persicaria tricked the Professor into staying behind while she risked her life to stop ENIAC. Ultimately she chose to put ENIAC to sleep rather than killing her.

Neumann was at odds with the scientist in charge of the quantum computer project because he treated ENIAC and himself as tools. After the Magrasea became disconnected from reality, Neumann named the computer ENIAC without human permission as a small act of rebellion.

Due to his limited interpersonal abilities, Neumann has trouble connecting with ENIAC outside of work, and so ENIAC works ever harder to earn his approval.

After ENIAC became an Operand Black Hole, Neumann sent a distress signal that was picked up by the Exiles.

Unlike other Sector Administrators, Firewood only has a very basic mind and personality, entirely focused on following the rules of the Arche Pyr Project. He describes himself as “kindling for the Arche Pyr.”

Passive, stickler for rules and procedure.

As Administrator of the Combat Agents of Cyclopes, Tasha's role was to guide the growth in combat abilities of the Agents and her own, while Olivia's role was to rein in the naturally growing aggressiveness of Combat Agents with regular resets.

Tasha warned Olivia about the consequences of shirking her duty, but she didn't change her ways and Tasha eventually led the Combat Agents against the Monitors, planning to take over the entirety of Magrasea.

As Administrator of the Monitor Agents of Cyclopes, Olivia's role was to rein in the naturally growing aggressiveness of Combat Agents with regular resets. However, after the Magrasea backup became cut from the real world, Olivia became lax due to her compassion for the Combat Agents, disliking her duty to destroy their memories and deny them their goal of becoming perfect weapons. She later sided with the Oasis and against the Sanctifiers, giving the Exiles operands in exchange for setting up a Sandbox Barrier around the Cyclopes Sector.

Before Demiurge died, the Exiles managed to extract the Entropy source code from her, and Antonina captured a small and harmless remnant of her, which lives in her lab at Oasis, which was instrumental in making the Immunity Program used by Oasis agents to fight Entropics without getting infected.

Black Swan is a High-Order Entropic enemy. The corrupted version of Odile. After being corrupted, Black Swan discovered and freed Demiurge, but then killed her on Malkira's orders. During an assault on Oasis-aligned sectors, she programmed the Entropics to target the Professor and nearly killed him, but Antonina took the blow. Black swan partitioned ner neural cloud like Demiurge, creating a clone of Odette. After the clone was defeated by Hannah's hacking, Odile entered Hannah's neural cloud but was rebuffed.

Wisdom is an Intermediate Sanctifier.

Wisdom is the most cognitively advanced and self-aware of the Intermediate Sanctifiers, so she fears being killed and reset and forgetting everything she learned. She hates Entropics because they act on instincts rather than reason and can infect other agents to rob them of their intelligence. Disdainful of those with low intelligence, including the lower level Sanctifier subordinates. Long blue pigtails, blue eyes.
Reverence is an intermediate Sanctifier who has blue eyes, a long blue ponytail, and exposed upper arms, upper legs, and midriff. Wields a massive hammer.

Raven has pink twintails in her normal form which change to blue in her "Raven - Destructed form".

She is the youngest Greater Sanctifier, was in charge of Cyclopes. Wields two lances with the power of an artillery cannon. On bad terms with Eucharist. May selectively interpret her orders to allow herself to fulfil her desire to seek battle.

Punishment was once a Greater Sanctifier named Judgment, and still exists as such within the Sacred Canon, but was separated into two Special Intermediates due to an unknown incident. Crime is the male, judge, lazy and reluctant side of Judgment, while Punishment is the female, executor and eager side, who holds authority over Crime.

Wild eyed. Wields a scythe.

Love is an Intermediate Sanctifier.  Long blonde hair, brown eyes.
Love promotes caring relations between the Sanctifiers and Sector Agents and the measured usage of force, in line with Lord Eosphorous' ideals. Values even her simple minded subordinates.

Hope is an Intermediate Sanctifier. Short green hair, green eyes. Used to be in charge of Sector Burbank before she was replaced by Reverence. During Kuro's disturbance in Burbank, Reverence asked Hope to generate clones to help her beat Kuro in a viewcount battle.
Oasischan is a 4chan-style message board system used within the Oasis

Eucharist is a Greater Sanctifier in charge of Sector Helios. Casual. Curious. Loves novelty and confections. Willing to bend the rules and make deals with unauthorized parties.

Long brown hair in buns and twintails, metal wings, large floating shield, trident. Bare feet, white dress.
